Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["browser" => ["mode" => "always"]]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::interact($engine, $url, [PageAction::from_json('{"selector":"#open","type":"click"}'), PageAction::from_json('{"selector":"#field","text":"test_data","type":"type"}'), PageAction::from_json('{"selector":"#submit","type":"click"}')]);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[0]->actionIndex);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[0]->actionType);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[0]->success);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[1]->actionIndex);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[1]->actionType);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[1]->success);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[2]->actionIndex);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[2]->actionType);
var_dump($result->getActionResults()[2]->success);
```
